technical.derivative: Full-frame 8-bit H264 CRF18, medium preset, original AAC stream copy, faststart; no crop, zoom, cut or retiming.
technical.edge_inspection: Source bottom edge inspected at10s and contact samples; no V4-style corrupted strip observed, no crop applied.

original_audio.audio_insertion_offset_convention: Positive means reference audio is placed later in the candidate; negative means the candidate begins partway into the reference.
original_audio.interpretation: Waveform placement and similarity only; the insertion offset is not a measured audiovisual lip-sync offset. Low correlation or a search-boundary result does not establish reliable audio placement. Segment windows use reference time and the same fitted offset; unavailable windows are null.

visual_review.observations: Visible gestures across opening, middle and question; hands return to rest. Sampled fingers, wrist continuity and table contacts are plausible. Face and framing remain coherent in inspected frames. Restored final lips closed at20.5s and21s.
visual_review.craft_concern: Repeated inward/outward palm gestures around7–12.75s may feel rehearsed. Owner review required to judge the desired amount of motion.

limitations: Frame sampling is not continuous perceptual assessment.
Waveform correlation verifies original narration presence, not audiovisual lip synchronization.
Playback completion is verified on the host browser; physical phone playback was not observed.
More hand movement is established; improved naturalness and owner acceptance are not yet established.
